correctness.rationale: For every \(q=2^m\), \(m\ge2\), the four explicit generator rows imply Vandermonde independence of distinct value columns and a two-dimensional derivative-column span; examining every 2/3/4-type composition yields only triple derivatives and 3-value+1-derivative circuits. The Hasse derivative of the vanishing cubic gives d²=ab+ac+bc, automatically avoiding a,b,c. Inverse offsets identify the projective Steiner system exactly. Every value repair uses >=2 other value coordinates by the (row 0,row 2) projection, giving floor((q-1)/2), and the primitive-element pairing constructs that many pairwise disjoint valid triples with distinct derivative indices. Nonzero multipliers preserve support dependence. Independently exhaustive GF(4),GF(8),GF(16) checker verifies exact circuit sets by Gaussian elimination and all constructed repairs. No infinite claim is inferred only from finite checks.

value.rationale: The motivating problem is exact local single-symbol recovery in a standard Hasse-derivative evaluation code. Unlike an ordinary minimum distance or NRT-MDS guarantee, a complete small-circuit support classification tells the precise repair choices for every coordinate. The projective Steiner correspondence explains a nontrivial incidence design, and an all-size sharp disjoint bound quantifies failure-tolerant recovery of every value coordinate. The result is structural over every even field and not merely a machine census or a textbook parameter substitution.
